commit.message:
Implement the MOSConventionalSSA pass (#606)

* [LiveVariables] Ignore undef PHI inputs when splitting edges

The addNewBlock overload without precomputed live-in sets must ignore undef
PHI inputs, just as the other overload has since 2cc77b2b8a022. Otherwise,
splitting an edge introduces spurious AliveBlocks entries.

Assisted by GPT-6 Astra.

* Implement the MOSConventionalSSA pass

@@ -0,0 +1,272 @@
+# NOTE: Assertions have been autogenerated by utils/update_mir_test_checks.py UTC_ARGS: --version 6
+# RUN: llc -mtriple=mos -run-pass=mos-conventional-ssa -verify-machineinstrs %s -o - | FileCheck %s
+
+# Both projections become whole-register tied inputs. The original pair remains
+# live, so allocation must preserve its low byte across the destructive updates.
+---
+name: tied_projections
+tracksRegLiveness: true
+body: |
+  bb.0:
+    ; CHECK-LABEL: name: tied_projections
+    ; CHECK: [[LDAbs:%[0-9]+]]:gpr = LDAbs 1000
+    ; CHECK-NEXT: [[LDAbs1:%[0-9]+]]:gpr = LDAbs 1001
+    ; CHECK-NEXT: [[REG_SEQUENCE:%[0-9]+]]:imag16 = REG_SEQUENCE killed [[LDAbs]], %subreg.sublo, killed [[LDAbs1]], %subreg.subhi
+    ; CHECK-NEXT: [[COPY:%[0-9]+]]:anyi8 = COPY [[REG_SEQUENCE]].sublo
+    ; CHECK-NEXT: [[IncMB:%[0-9]+]]:anyi8 = IncMB killed [[COPY]](tied-def 0), implicit-def dead $c, implicit-def dead $v
+    ; CHECK-NEXT: [[COPY1:%[0-9]+]]:anyi8 = COPY [[REG_SEQUENCE]].subhi
+    ; CHECK-NEXT: [[IncMB1:%[0-9]+]]:anyi8 = IncMB killed [[COPY1]](tied-def 0), implicit-def dead $c, implicit-def dead $v
+    ; CHECK-NEXT: [[COPY2:%[0-9]+]]:gpr = COPY killed [[REG_SEQUENCE]].sublo
+    ; CHECK-NEXT: [[COPY3:%[0-9]+]]:gpr = COPY killed [[IncMB]]
+    ; CHECK-NEXT: [[COPY4:%[0-9]+]]:gpr = COPY killed [[IncMB1]]
+    ; CHECK-NEXT: STAbs killed [[COPY3]], 2000
+    ; CHECK-NEXT: STAbs killed [[COPY4]], 2001
+    ; CHECK-NEXT: STAbs killed [[COPY2]], 2002
+    ; CHECK-NEXT: RTS
+    %0:gpr = LDAbs 1000
+    %1:gpr = LDAbs 1001
+    %2:imag16 = REG_SEQUENCE %0, %subreg.sublo, %1, %subreg.subhi
+    %3:anyi8 = IncMB %2.sublo(tied-def 0), implicit-def $c, implicit-def $v
+    %4:anyi8 = IncMB %2.subhi(tied-def 0), implicit-def $c, implicit-def $v
+    %5:gpr = COPY %2.sublo
+    %6:gpr = COPY %3
+    %7:gpr = COPY %4
+    STAbs %6, 2000
+    STAbs %7, 2001
+    STAbs %5, 2002
+    RTS
+...
+
+# An undef subregister input becomes a fresh whole-register IMPLICIT_DEF,
+# used as the killed input of the tie.
+---
+name: undef_tied_projection
+tracksRegLiveness: true
+body: |
+  bb.0:
+    ; CHECK-LABEL: name: undef_tied_projection
+    ; CHECK: dead [[DEF:%[0-9]+]]:imag16 = IMPLICIT_DEF
+    ; CHECK-NEXT: [[DEF1:%[0-9]+]]:anyi8 = IMPLICIT_DEF
+    ; CHECK-NEXT: [[IncMB:%[0-9]+]]:anyi8 = IncMB killed [[DEF1]](tied-def 0), implicit-def dead $c, implicit-def dead $v
+    ; CHECK-NEXT: [[COPY:%[0-9]+]]:gpr = COPY killed [[IncMB]]
+    ; CHECK-NEXT: STAbs killed [[COPY]], 2000
+    ; CHECK-NEXT: RTS
+    %0:imag16 = IMPLICIT_DEF
+    %1:anyi8 = IncMB undef %0.subhi(tied-def 0), implicit-def $c, implicit-def $v
+    %2:gpr = COPY %1
+    STAbs %2, 2000
+    RTS
+...
+
+# Preserve a tied input that is also used after the destructive instruction.
+---
+name: live_tied_input
+tracksRegLiveness: true
+body: |
+  bb.0:
+    liveins: $a
+    ; CHECK-LABEL: name: live_tied_input
+    ; CHECK: liveins: $a
+    ; CHECK-NEXT: {{  $}}
+    ; CHECK-NEXT: [[COPY:%[0-9]+]]:anyi8 = COPY killed $a
+    ; CHECK-NEXT: [[COPY1:%[0-9]+]]:anyi8 = COPY [[COPY]]
+    ; CHECK-NEXT: [[IncMB:%[0-9]+]]:anyi8 = IncMB killed [[COPY1]](tied-def 0), implicit-def dead $c, implicit-def dead $v
+    ; CHECK-NEXT: $x = COPY killed [[COPY]]
+    ; CHECK-NEXT: $a = COPY killed [[IncMB]]
+    ; CHECK-NEXT: RTS implicit killed $x, implicit killed $a
+    %0:anyi8 = COPY $a
+    %1:anyi8 = IncMB %0(tied-def 0), implicit-def $c, implicit-def $v
+    $x = COPY %0
+    $a = COPY %1
+    RTS implicit $x, implicit $a
+...
+
+# A sole use in the result's class already has the required lifetime, even
+# without an incoming kill flag. The second tie needs a class-changing copy.
+---
+name: sole_tied_inputs
+tracksRegLiveness: true
+body: |
+  bb.0:
+    ; CHECK-LABEL: name: sole_tied_inputs
+    ; CHECK: [[LDImm:%[0-9]+]]:gpr = LDImm 1
+    ; CHECK-NEXT: [[IncMB:%[0-9]+]]:gpr = IncMB killed [[LDImm]](tied-def 0), implicit-def dead $c, implicit-def dead $v
+    ; CHECK-NEXT: [[COPY:%[0-9]+]]:imag8 = COPY killed [[IncMB]]
+    ; CHECK-NEXT: [[IncMB1:%[0-9]+]]:imag8 = IncMB killed [[COPY]](tied-def 0), implicit-def dead $c, implicit-def dead $v
+    ; CHECK-NEXT: $a = COPY killed [[IncMB1]]
+    ; CHECK-NEXT: RTS implicit killed $a
+    %0:gpr = LDImm 1
+    %1:gpr = IncMB %0(tied-def 0), implicit-def $c, implicit-def $v
+    %2:imag8 = IncMB %1(tied-def 0), implicit-def $c, implicit-def $v
+    $a = COPY %2
+    RTS implicit $a
+...
+
+# Even if the source dies here, its two destructive continuations must be
+# independently assignable. IncMB models the two bytes of an increment.
+---
+name: repeated_tied_input
+tracksRegLiveness: true
+body: |
+  bb.0:
+    ; CHECK-LABEL: name: repeated_tied_input
+    ; CHECK: [[LDImm:%[0-9]+]]:gpr = LDImm 1
+    ; CHECK-NEXT: [[COPY:%[0-9]+]]:gpr = COPY [[LDImm]]
+    ; CHECK-NEXT: [[IncMB:%[0-9]+]]:gpr, [[IncMB1:%[0-9]+]]:gpr = IncMB killed [[COPY]](tied-def 0), killed [[LDImm]](tied-def 1), implicit-def dead $c, implicit-def dead $v
+    ; CHECK-NEXT: $a = COPY killed [[IncMB]]
+    ; CHECK-NEXT: $x = COPY killed [[IncMB1]]
+    ; CHECK-NEXT: RTS implicit killed $a, implicit killed $x
+    %0:gpr = LDImm 1
+    %1:gpr, %2:gpr = IncMB %0(tied-def 0), killed %0(tied-def 1), implicit-def $c, implicit-def $v
+    $a = COPY %1
+    $x = COPY %2
+    RTS implicit $a, implicit $x
+...
+
+# The early result may overwrite its input before the other use is read.
+# The input COPY must therefore remain distinct from the ordinary use.
+---
+name: early_clobber_tie
+tracksRegLiveness: true
+body: |
+  bb.0:
+    liveins: $a
+    ; CHECK-LABEL: name: early_clobber_tie
+    ; CHECK: liveins: $a
+    ; CHECK-NEXT: {{  $}}
+    ; CHECK-NEXT: [[COPY:%[0-9]+]]:imag8 = COPY killed $a
+    ; CHECK-NEXT: [[COPY1:%[0-9]+]]:imag8 = COPY [[COPY]]
+    ; CHECK-NEXT: INLINEASM &"", sideeffect attdialect, regdef-ec:Imag8, def early-clobber %1, reguse tiedto:$0, killed [[COPY1]](tied-def 3), reguse:Imag8, killed [[COPY]]
+    ; CHECK-NEXT: $a = COPY killed %1
+    ; CHECK-NEXT: RTS implicit killed $a
+    %0:imag8 = COPY $a
+    INLINEASM &"", sideeffect attdialect, regdef-ec:Imag8, def early-clobber %1:imag8, reguse tiedto:$0, %0(tied-def 3), reguse:Imag8, killed %0
+    $a = COPY %1
+    RTS implicit $a
+...
+
+# The asm requires an Imag8 tie, while STAbs requires a GPR result. Isolate the
+# definition so the tie's class does not inherit the later use's constraint.
+---
+name: constrained_tied_result
+tracksRegLiveness: true
+body: |
+  bb.0:
+    liveins: $a
+    ; CHECK-LABEL: name: constrained_tied_result
+    ; CHECK: liveins: $a
+    ; CHECK-NEXT: {{  $}}
+    ; CHECK-NEXT: [[COPY:%[0-9]+]]:imag8 = COPY killed $a
+    ; CHECK-NEXT: INLINEASM &"", sideeffect attdialect, regdef:Imag8, def %2, reguse tiedto:$0, killed [[COPY]](tied-def 3)
+    ; CHECK-NEXT: [[COPY1:%[0-9]+]]:gpr = COPY killed %2
+    ; CHECK-NEXT: STAbs killed [[COPY1]], 2000
+    ; CHECK-NEXT: RTS
+    %0:imag8 = COPY $a
+    INLINEASM &"", sideeffect attdialect, regdef:Imag8, def %1:gpr, reguse tiedto:$0, %0(tied-def 3)
+    STAbs %1, 2000
+    RTS
+...
+
+# Existing physical ties already describe in-place updates.
+---
+name: physical_tie
+tracksRegLiveness: true
+body: |
+  bb.0:
+    liveins: $a
+    ; CHECK-LABEL: name: physical_tie
+    ; CHECK: liveins: $a
+    ; CHECK-NEXT: {{  $}}
+    ; CHECK-NEXT: $a = IncMB $a(tied-def 0), implicit-def dead $c, implicit-def dead $v, implicit killed $alsb
+    ; CHECK-NEXT: RTS implicit killed $a
+    $a = IncMB killed $a(tied-def 0), implicit-def $c, implicit-def $v
+    RTS implicit $a
+...
+
+# A single textual use inside a loop does not kill a value defined outside it.
+# Each iteration must increment the original input, not the previous result.
+---
+name: loop_tied_input
+tracksRegLiveness: true
+body: |
+  ; CHECK-LABEL: name: loop_tied_input
+  ; CHECK: bb.0:
+  ; CHECK-NEXT:   successors: %bb.1(0x80000000)
+  ; CHECK-NEXT: {{  $}}
+  ; CHECK-NEXT:   [[LDAbs:%[0-9]+]]:gpr = LDAbs 1000
+  ; CHECK-NEXT:   JMP %bb.1
+  ; CHECK-NEXT: {{  $}}
+  ; CHECK-NEXT: bb.1:
+  ; CHECK-NEXT:   successors: %bb.1(0x40000000), %bb.2(0x40000000)
+  ; CHECK-NEXT: {{  $}}
+  ; CHECK-NEXT:   [[COPY:%[0-9]+]]:gpr = COPY [[LDAbs]]
+  ; CHECK-NEXT:   [[IncMB:%[0-9]+]]:gpr = IncMB killed [[COPY]](tied-def 0), implicit-def dead $c, implicit-def dead $v
+  ; CHECK-NEXT:   CmpBrZero %bb.1, undef $z, 1, [[IncMB]], implicit-def dead $c
+  ; CHECK-NEXT:   JMP %bb.2
+  ; CHECK-NEXT: {{  $}}
+  ; CHECK-NEXT: bb.2:
+  ; CHECK-NEXT:   STAbs killed [[IncMB]], 2000
+  ; CHECK-NEXT:   RTS
+  bb.0:
+    %0:gpr = LDAbs 1000
+    JMP %bb.1
+  bb.1:
+    successors: %bb.1, %bb.2
+    %1:gpr = IncMB %0(tied-def 0), implicit-def $c, implicit-def $v
+    CmpBrZero %bb.1, undef $z, 1, %1, implicit-def $c
+    JMP %bb.2
+  bb.2:
+    STAbs %1, 2000
+    RTS
+...
+
+# Earlier uses and a definition in another block do not prevent a tie from
+# taking over the input at its final use. No incoming kill flag is required.
+---
+name: cross_block_killed_input
+tracksRegLiveness: true
+body: |
+  ; CHECK-LABEL: name: cross_block_killed_input
+  ; CHECK: bb.0:
+  ; CHECK-NEXT:   successors: %bb.1(0x80000000)
+  ; CHECK-NEXT: {{  $}}
+  ; CHECK-NEXT:   [[LDAbs:%[0-9]+]]:gpr = LDAbs 1000
+  ; CHECK-NEXT:   STAbs [[LDAbs]], 2000
+  ; CHECK-NEXT:   JMP %bb.1
+  ; CHECK-NEXT: {{  $}}
+  ; CHECK-NEXT: bb.1:
+  ; CHECK-NEXT:   [[IncMB:%[0-9]+]]:gpr = IncMB killed [[LDAbs]](tied-def 0), implicit-def dead $c, implicit-def dead $v
+  ; CHECK-NEXT:   STAbs killed [[IncMB]], 2001
+  ; CHECK-NEXT:   RTS
+  bb.0:
+    %0:gpr = LDAbs 1000
+    STAbs %0, 2000
+    JMP %bb.1
+  bb.1:
+    %1:gpr = IncMB %0(tied-def 0), implicit-def $c, implicit-def $v
+    STAbs %1, 2001
+    RTS
+...
+
+# An ordinary tied result can reuse a dying input even if the instruction
+# also reads it through an untied operand: both reads precede the definition.
+# Put the untied operand first so LiveVariables marks it as the kill. CSSA
+# should neither introduce a copy nor add a kill to the tied operand.
+---
+name: ordinary_tie_with_other_use
+tracksRegLiveness: true
+body: |
+  bb.0:
+    liveins: $a
+    ; CHECK-LABEL: name: ordinary_tie_with_other_use
+    ; CHECK: liveins: $a
+    ; CHECK-NEXT: {{  $}}
+    ; CHECK-NEXT: [[COPY:%[0-9]+]]:imag8 = COPY killed $a
+    ; CHECK-NEXT: INLINEASM &"", sideeffect attdialect, reguse:Imag8, killed [[COPY]], regdef:Imag8, def %1, reguse tiedto:$1, [[COPY]](tied-def 5)
+    ; CHECK-NEXT: $a = COPY killed %1
+    ; CHECK-NEXT: RTS implicit killed $a
+    %0:imag8 = COPY $a
+    INLINEASM &"", sideeffect attdialect, reguse:Imag8, %0, regdef:Imag8, def %1:imag8, reguse tiedto:$1, %0(tied-def 5)
+    $a = COPY %1
+    RTS implicit $a
+...

@@ -0,0 +1,224 @@
+# NOTE: Assertions have been autogenerated by utils/update_mir_test_checks.py UTC_ARGS: --version 6
+# RUN: llc -mtriple=mos -run-pass=mos-conventional-ssa -verify-machineinstrs -o - %s | FileCheck %s
+
+# The machine verifier also checks the LiveVariables analysis preserved by CSSA.
+
+# The old PHI result survives on the exit edge; the backedge copy must define
+# a fresh name rather than overwrite it.
+---
+name: lost_copy
+tracksRegLiveness: true
+body: |
+  ; CHECK-LABEL: name: lost_copy
+  ; CHECK: bb.0:
+  ; CHECK-NEXT:   successors: %bb.1(0x80000000)
+  ; CHECK-NEXT: {{  $}}
+  ; CHECK-NEXT:   [[LDAbs:%[0-9]+]]:gpr = LDAbs 1000
+  ; CHECK-NEXT:   [[PCOPY:%[0-9]+]]:anyi8 = PCOPY killed [[LDAbs]]
+  ; CHECK-NEXT:   JMP %bb.1
+  ; CHECK-NEXT: {{  $}}
+  ; CHECK-NEXT: bb.1:
+  ; CHECK-NEXT:   successors: %bb.1(0x40000000), %bb.2(0x40000000)
+  ; CHECK-NEXT: {{  $}}
+  ; CHECK-NEXT:   [[PHI:%[0-9]+]]:anyi8 = PHI [[PCOPY]], %bb.0, %5, %bb.1
+  ; CHECK-NEXT:   [[PCOPY1:%[0-9]+]]:gpr = PCOPY killed [[PHI]]
+  ; CHECK-NEXT:   [[COPY:%[0-9]+]]:gpr = COPY [[PCOPY1]]
+  ; CHECK-NEXT:   [[IncMB:%[0-9]+]]:gpr = IncMB killed [[COPY]](tied-def 0), implicit-def dead $c, implicit-def dead $v
+  ; CHECK-NEXT:   [[PCOPY2:%[0-9]+]]:anyi8 = PCOPY [[IncMB]]
+  ; CHECK-NEXT:   CmpBrZero %bb.1, undef $z, 1, [[IncMB]], implicit-def dead $c
+  ; CHECK-NEXT:   JMP %bb.2
+  ; CHECK-NEXT: {{  $}}
+  ; CHECK-NEXT: bb.2:
+  ; CHECK-NEXT:   STAbs killed [[PCOPY1]], 2000
+  ; CHECK-NEXT:   STAbs killed [[IncMB]], 2001
+  ; CHECK-NEXT:   RTS
+  bb.0:
+    %0:gpr = LDAbs 1000
+    JMP %bb.1
+  bb.1:
+    successors: %bb.1, %bb.2
+    %1:gpr = PHI %0, %bb.0, %2, %bb.1
+    %2:gpr = IncMB %1(tied-def 0), implicit-def $c, implicit-def $v
+    CmpBrZero %bb.1, undef $z, 1, %2, implicit-def $c
+    JMP %bb.2
+  bb.2:
+    STAbs %1, 2000
+    STAbs %2, 2001
+    RTS
+...
+---
+# Isolate all results together so mutually dependent PHIs remain parallel.
+name: swap
+tracksRegLiveness: true
+body: |
+  ; CHECK-LABEL: name: swap
+  ; CHECK: bb.0:
+  ; CHECK-NEXT:   successors: %bb.1(0x80000000)
+  ; CHECK-NEXT: {{  $}}
+  ; CHECK-NEXT:   [[LDAbs:%[0-9]+]]:gpr = LDAbs 1000
+  ; CHECK-NEXT:   [[LDAbs1:%[0-9]+]]:gpr = LDAbs 1001
+  ; CHECK-NEXT:   [[PCOPY:%[0-9]+]]:anyi8, [[PCOPY1:%[0-9]+]]:anyi8 = PCOPY killed [[LDAbs]], killed [[LDAbs1]]
+  ; CHECK-NEXT:   JMP %bb.1
+  ; CHECK-NEXT: {{  $}}
+  ; CHECK-NEXT: bb.1:
+  ; CHECK-NEXT:   successors: %bb.1(0x40000000), %bb.2(0x40000000)
+  ; CHECK-NEXT: {{  $}}
+  ; CHECK-NEXT:   [[PHI:%[0-9]+]]:anyi8 = PHI [[PCOPY]], %bb.0, %7, %bb.1
+  ; CHECK-NEXT:   [[PHI1:%[0-9]+]]:anyi8 = PHI [[PCOPY1]], %bb.0, %9, %bb.1
+  ; CHECK-NEXT:   [[PCOPY2:%[0-9]+]]:gpr, [[PCOPY3:%[0-9]+]]:gpr = PCOPY killed [[PHI]], killed [[PHI1]]
+  ; CHECK-NEXT:   STAbs [[PCOPY2]], 2000
+  ; CHECK-NEXT:   STAbs [[PCOPY3]], 2001
+  ; CHECK-NEXT:   [[PCOPY4:%[0-9]+]]:anyi8, [[PCOPY5:%[0-9]+]]:anyi8 = PCOPY killed [[PCOPY3]], [[PCOPY2]]
+  ; CHECK-NEXT:   CmpBrZero %bb.1, undef $z, 1, killed [[PCOPY2]], implicit-def dead $c
+  ; CHECK-NEXT:   JMP %bb.2
+  ; CHECK-NEXT: {{  $}}
+  ; CHECK-NEXT: bb.2:
+  ; CHECK-NEXT:   RTS
+  bb.0:
+    %0:gpr = LDAbs 1000
+    %1:gpr = LDAbs 1001
+    JMP %bb.1
+  bb.1:
+    successors: %bb.1, %bb.2
+    %2:gpr = PHI %0, %bb.0, %3, %bb.1
+    %3:gpr = PHI %1, %bb.0, %2, %bb.1
+    STAbs %2, 2000
+    STAbs %3, 2001
+    CmpBrZero %bb.1, undef $z, 1, %2, implicit-def $c
+    JMP %bb.2
+  bb.2:
+    RTS
+...
+# One outgoing PCOPY serves both PHI successors of each predecessor, for both
+# direct and indirect branches. Critical edges remain intact.
+---
+name: indirect_successors
+tracksRegLiveness: true
+body: |
+  ; CHECK-LABEL: name: indirect_successors
+  ; CHECK: bb.0:
+  ; CHECK-NEXT:   successors: %bb.1(0x2aaaaaab), %bb.2(0x2aaaaaab), %bb.3(0x2aaaaaab)
+  ; CHECK-NEXT:   liveins: $rs0
+  ; CHECK-NEXT: {{  $}}
+  ; CHECK-NEXT:   [[LDAbs:%[0-9]+]]:gpr = LDAbs 1000
+  ; CHECK-NEXT:   [[LDAbs1:%[0-9]+]]:gpr = LDAbs 1001
+  ; CHECK-NEXT:   [[PCOPY:%[0-9]+]]:anyi8, [[PCOPY1:%[0-9]+]]:anyi8 = PCOPY [[LDAbs]], [[LDAbs1]]
+  ; CHECK-NEXT:   JMPIndir $rs0
+  ; CHECK-NEXT: {{  $}}
+  ; CHECK-NEXT: bb.1:
+  ; CHECK-NEXT:   successors: %bb.2(0x40000000), %bb.3(0x40000000)
+  ; CHECK-NEXT: {{  $}}
+  ; CHECK-NEXT:   [[PCOPY2:%[0-9]+]]:anyi8, [[PCOPY3:%[0-9]+]]:anyi8 = PCOPY killed [[LDAbs1]], [[LDAbs]]
+  ; CHECK-NEXT:   CmpBrZero %bb.2, undef $z, 1, killed [[LDAbs]], implicit-def dead $c
+  ; CHECK-NEXT:   JMP %bb.3
+  ; CHECK-NEXT: {{  $}}
+  ; CHECK-NEXT: bb.2:
+  ; CHECK-NEXT:   [[PHI:%[0-9]+]]:anyi8 = PHI [[PCOPY]], %bb.0, [[PCOPY2]], %bb.1
+  ; CHECK-NEXT:   [[PCOPY4:%[0-9]+]]:gpr = PCOPY killed [[PHI]]
+  ; CHECK-NEXT:   STAbs killed [[PCOPY4]], 2000
+  ; CHECK-NEXT:   RTS
+  ; CHECK-NEXT: {{  $}}
+  ; CHECK-NEXT: bb.3:
+  ; CHECK-NEXT:   [[PHI1:%[0-9]+]]:anyi8 = PHI [[PCOPY1]], %bb.0, [[PCOPY3]], %bb.1
+  ; CHECK-NEXT:   [[PCOPY5:%[0-9]+]]:gpr = PCOPY killed [[PHI1]]
+  ; CHECK-NEXT:   STAbs killed [[PCOPY5]], 2001
+  ; CHECK-NEXT:   RTS
+  bb.0:
+    successors: %bb.1, %bb.2, %bb.3
+    liveins: $rs0
+    %0:gpr = LDAbs 1000
+    %1:gpr = LDAbs 1001
+    JMPIndir $rs0
+  bb.1:
+    successors: %bb.2, %bb.3
+    CmpBrZero %bb.2, undef $z, 1, %0, implicit-def $c
+    JMP %bb.3
+  bb.2:
+    %2:gpr = PHI %0, %bb.0, %1, %bb.1
+    STAbs %2, 2000
+    RTS
+  bb.3:
+    %3:gpr = PHI %1, %bb.0, %0, %bb.1
+    STAbs %3, 2001
+    RTS
+...
+# Preserve subregister sources and leave undef inputs untouched. A dead PHI
+# result needs no output copy, but its non-undef inputs are still isolated.
+---
+name: operand_flags
+tracksRegLiveness: true
+body: |
+  ; CHECK-LABEL: name: operand_flags
+  ; CHECK: bb.0:
+  ; CHECK-NEXT:   successors: %bb.1(0x40000000), %bb.2(0x40000000)
+  ; CHECK-NEXT:   liveins: $rs0
+  ; CHECK-NEXT: {{  $}}
+  ; CHECK-NEXT:   [[COPY:%[0-9]+]]:imag16 = COPY $rs0
+  ; CHECK-NEXT:   [[LDAbs:%[0-9]+]]:gpr = LDAbs 1000
+  ; CHECK-NEXT:   [[PCOPY:%[0-9]+]]:anyi8 = PCOPY [[COPY]].sublo
+  ; CHECK-NEXT:   CmpBrZero %bb.2, undef $z, 1, killed [[LDAbs]], implicit-def dead $c
+  ; CHECK-NEXT:   JMP %bb.1
+  ; CHECK-NEXT: {{  $}}
+  ; CHECK-NEXT: bb.1:
+  ; CHECK-NEXT:   successors: %bb.2(0x80000000)
+  ; CHECK-NEXT: {{  $}}
+  ; CHECK-NEXT:   [[PCOPY1:%[0-9]+]]:anyi8, [[PCOPY2:%[0-9]+]]:imag16 = PCOPY killed [[COPY]].subhi, [[COPY]]
+  ; CHECK-NEXT:   JMP %bb.2
